name: VL53L0X Time-of-Flight Distance Sensor Carrier (Pololu 2490)
description: Laser distance sensor on a carrier with a 2.8 V regulator and I²C level shifters. Power VIN from 3.3 V so SDA/SCL idle at 3.3 V.

pins.name: XSHUT
pins.description: Active-low shutdown, pulled up to 2.8 V on the board, not level-shifted. Drive it open-drain: OUTPUT LOW, or INPUT for high.

pins.name: GPIO1
pins.description: Open-drain interrupt output, pulled up to 2.8 V.

notes: Published: VIN 2.8-5.5 V (Pololu pin table; the prose says 2.6 V); 2.8 V LDO with about 100 mA spare; SDA/SCL shifted to VIN; XSHUT not level-shifted (abs max 3.6 V); default address 0x29, changed in software and lost on reset; 20 mA typical, 40 mA peak; 13 x 18 x 2 mm, 0.5 g. ST datasheet: 25 deg field of view; default mode about 1.2 m range with 33 ms timing budget (about 30 Hz); accuracy 4% (1 sigma) on a white target at 1.2 m. Minimum range 30 mm is Pololu's experience (not specified). rays is a sim choice.
